text:
maria: Running a short experiment: compare synthetic load vs replay harness with a hybrid config (KV warmup + speculative decoding). Want to sync on methodology and what to measure. TL;DR: focus p50/p95 latency, tokens/sec, and quality-regressions per eval set. thoughts?

jonah: +1. Propose three axes: request distribution, KV hit rate, batch size distribution. We should do pairwise comparisons with identical seeds and throughput targets.

kevin: For replay harness I'll use 100k anonymized requests sampled from prod (last 30d). Synthetic will use parametrized Zipf + prompt-length mix. Run both under the same token/sec envelope and measure kernel choice logs.

kevin: Example harness commands:
```
# replay
./harness/replay --trace /traces/last30d_sample.json --target-tokens-per-sec 50000 --dump-kernel-log /tmp/kernel.log
# synthetic
./harness/synth --dist zipf --shape 1.2 --seq-mix 128,512,1024 --target 50000 --dump-kernel-log /tmp/kernel_synth.log
```

sophia: Important: reset per-worker KV at start of each run so cold vs warm starts are clean. Track KV hit rate, prefix reuse, and per-request kv_latency.

maria: Quant profiles to test: fp16, int8, q4f16. Speculative decoding policy: off vs 2-token speculative. We'll measure quality using our eval suite (lm-regressions, compared on BLEU/ROUGE and our custom safety/regression checks).

jonah: We also need kernel selection telemetry per-batch: record kernel_id, seq_len, batch_size, kv_state. Add histograms for seq_len and batch_size and wire GPU tracing for p99 anomalies.

kevin: I can run a 6hr sweep on staging-dedicated. Matrix: KV_warmup=[0,1], speculative=[off,2-token], quant=[fp16,int8,q4f16] => 12 configs. Using fixed RNG seed so sampling is deterministic.

sophia: For comparison: run pairwise significance (sign test) on quality metrics and compute econ delta (cost per 1k tokens, latency SLO impact). Any config that shows a statistically significant quality regression beyond the regression gate gets auto-failed unless product pre-approves delta.

maria: Owned: @kevin run the sweep and upload raw logs, @jonah build dashboards and histograms, I'll draft regression gate thresholds and a short runbook for false positives.

deploy-bot: Cluster provisioning started for job sweep-1832109876 on staging-dedicated (6x A100). ETA ~ 2m :gear:

kevin: kicked off. I'll post final summary + diffs when done :thumbsup:

jonah: added a dashboard stub at https://grafana.internal/r/sweep-1832109876

sophia: one note: for int8 runs, measure hallucination spike — run our safety-check suite post-run.

maria: perfect. timeline: start today, finish by tomorrow EOD. thanks all.
